item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00432","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C04","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is the concrete administrative action that the child commemorates: it transfers United States occupation responsibilities in Austria to the Department of State and reorganizes authority over the High Commissioner. The child closely restates that specific transfer—contrasting the Department of State with the Department of the Army—and adapts it into a retirement letter praising General Keyes and Army personnel. C04 and C18 provide weaker structural analogues as personalized letters reviewing overseas service and expressing national gratitude, but neither matches the child's Austria-specific administrative transition.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Department of State will assume the occupation responsibilities which have heretofore been exercised by the Department of the Army through you","parent_excerpt":"There are hereby vested in the Department of State ... the responsibilities and obligations of the United States in connection with the occupation of Austria","explanation":"The child converts C03's operative transfer of Austrian occupation responsibilities into a concise retrospective description addressed to the outgoing High Commissioner."},{"child_excerpt":"We now mark the point in the history of the Occupation of Austria","parent_excerpt":"This order shall become effective on October 16, 1950.","explanation":"The child's reference to a newly reached transition point corresponds to the recent effective date of C03's reorganization."},{"child_excerpt":"the services you have rendered to your country as the United States High Commissioner to Austria","parent_excerpt":"The United States High Commissioner for Austria shall continue to be the supreme United States authority in Austria ... under the immediate supervision of the Secretary of State","explanation":"Both texts center the same office and its role within the newly transferred administrative structure."}]}
